richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Madanapalle

c: Madanapalle sits on the upland plateau of southern Andhra Pradesh, and it stays milder than the coastal plains for much of the year. The town is known for its large tomato market and for the residential schools in the hills around it. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Madanapalle for those schools, local colleges and residential layouts.

We build our Fun Fitness machines at our Vasai factory, about 880 km away, and send them to Andhra Pradesh by road. A dealer in south India or our own team handles installation. Pleasant weather means people use an outdoor gym through most of the day here, not only at dawn. The ground around the town is often rocky, so we usually grout each machine into a small concrete footing and mark it on the layout drawing first.

facts.label: Delivery and installation

items.q: Can a residential school in Madanapalle add an outdoor gym to its campus?
items.a: Yes. Send us the campus area you have in mind, the age of the students and a few photos. We will suggest machines and mark clear space around each one on a layout drawing.

items.q: How are machines fixed on rocky ground?
items.a: Our installers cut a small pit for each machine and grout it into concrete. On rock, the footing can be shallower, but it still needs to be level so the machine stands straight.

items.q: What warranty do you offer on gym equipment?
items.a: Three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts, covering manufacturing defects when installed and maintained as per our instructions.
